parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to which the bandwidth plan is attached.

parameters.name: GeographicRegionAId
parameters.description:
The ID of a connected area of the bandwidth plan. Valid values:

- **China**: the Chinese mainland.

- **North-America**: North America.

- **Asia-Pacific**: Asia Pacific.

- **Europe**: Europe.

parameters.name: GeographicRegionBId
parameters.description:
The ID of the other connected area of the bandwidth plan. Valid values:

- **China**: the Chinese mainland.

- **North-America**: North America.

- **Asia-Pacific**: Asia Pacific.

- **Europe**: Europe.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The default value is **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.
